title: 霜夜の星巡り：忘却の里の挽歌
author: 紅葉 鬼灯

prediction.question: 白銀の影の正体と、奏太の運命はどうなる？
options: 里の長が現れ、奏太を保護する
新たな敵が現れ、里が混乱に陥る
奏太の記憶にない親族が現れる

en.title: Stargazing on a Frosty Night: Elegy for the Forgotten Village
en.premise: Alongside an ancient family tree, what was left behind was a cryptic "star chart" that mapped the terrain of the earth rather than the heavens. On the night of the winter solstice, a young man stepping into the blank space indicated by the chart wanders into a village that was supposed to have vanished a century ago. There, he encounters sorrowful apparitions: beings who became yokai out of a lingering longing for humanity, continuing to protect a village where time has stood still.

zh.title: 霜夜星巡：遗忘之里的挽歌
zh.premise: 与古老的家谱一同留下的，并非描绘天空，而是记录着地上地形的神秘“星图”。冬至之夜，一名踏入星图所指空白之地的青年，误入了一个本应在百年前便突然消失的村庄。在那里，他遇见了一群悲伤的异形——他们因对人类的思念而化作妖怪，守护着这座时间停滞的村庄。
